assumptions.evidence: Local execution of controller routines 0800 and 0899 with synthetic mode-0 completion events; no DSC2847 signal association is assumed.
assumptions.interrupts: disabled by local CPU reset state
limitations: Local routine starts and an explicit caller frame are diagnostics, not reset-started execution.
Byte completions are synthetic events, not a model of serial pins, bit order, or oscillator timing.
Firmware byte order, masks and latch ordering do not identify physical switches, LEDs, sample channels, or DSP connections.
All-byte fixtures vary one payload position at a time, not all possible frames.

interpretation: Controller-side frame and handshake constraints only. No physical switch/LED mapping or DSC2847 connection is established.
